notes.title: Queen of Thieves update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27438937/780b195516b26a30d8ef04f948140d58163cbaea.jpg[/img]
[b]What's New in 1.0.4[/b]

- updated the framework to latest Ren'Py version
- several events could be replayed twice if certain conditions were triggered, allowing you to obtain much higher relationship points than possible, triggering some more uncommon behaviors
- while the game was preventing same love interest to be romanced by two sisters at same time, you could use one of the three sisters to romance more than one love interest if you kept the relationships high enough! This has been fixed, so that after you trigger the romance CG with one love interest, the others become unavailable (as it should always have been!)
